notes.title: 🧀 Cheese Maze - Patch Notes v1.0.171
notes.content: [h1]Greetings, Cheese Hunters! 🐭[/h1][p]We've rolled out an exciting new update packed with improvements to make your maze-running experience smoother and more accessible than ever![/p][p] [/p][h2]✨ New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]🌍 Added Language Support:[/b][/p][p]Cheese Maze is now available in multiple new languages! We're making the game more accessible to players around the world. You can select your preferred language through Steam.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]🐧 New Linux & Steam Deck Build:[/b][/p][p]Cheese Maze now runs natively on [b]Linux[/b] and is fully compatible with the [b]Steam Deck[/b]! Whether you're on the go or on your desktop, the hunt for cheese never stops. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🔧 Engine & Performance[/h2][list][*][p][b]🚀 Upgraded to the Latest Engine Version:[/b][/p][p]We've updated the game to the latest version of the Unity engine to ensure better performance, stability, and compatibility across devices.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🎨 UI Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p][b]🖥️ Updated User Interface:[/b][/p][p]The UI has been refreshed with cleaner visuals and improved usability. Menus, buttons, and HUD elements have been redesigned for a more polished and intuitive experience. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback helps make Cheese Maze even better. Stay cheesy![/p]

notes.title: Update v1.0.166
notes.content:
[h1]Cheese Maze Update v1.0.166[/h1]

Fixed initial sound volume loading and volume slider. It will now correctly save and load the volumes. The in-game timer display now shows correct times.
The level selection now always starts at the first page.

Thank you for playing Cheese Maze and giving Feedback!

notes.title: Update v1.0.165
notes.content:
[h1]Cheese Maze Update v1.0.165[/h1]

We have enabled the "Unity Resolution Dialog" to address some issues with the initial resolution on some systems with non common resolutions. 

Thank you for playing Cheese Maze and giving Feedback!
